explanations: feesFor returns the zone's one shared FeeSchedule object, and adjustForOrder writes this order's surge, free-delivery and small-order adjustments into it. Every quote changes the schedule for every later quote and for courierPayout, which reads the same object, until the process restarts. So surge compounds, a big basket's free delivery carries over to the next customer, and courier pay drifts. The quote module is coupled to the fee module's internal state when it should only read it. The fix gives adjustForOrder a per-order copy ({ ...feesFor(order.zone) }), so the zone schedule stays the read-only source of truth that quotes and courier pay both rely on.
